_note: Wheel of Misfortune slips (Play spec 9): bureaucracy jokes only, never about the misfortune itself.
slips: Your claim was filed on Form 9 instead of Form 9b.
The bad news was approved in triplicate.
A clerk stamped DENIED before reading the page.
Your case will be processed in six to eight weeks.
The Ministry lost your file, found it, then lost it again.
The fine print had its own fine print.
Your case went to the Department of Maybe.
The waiting room has a waiting room.
The helpline put you on hold with smooth jazz.
The paperwork arrived. It was mostly more paperwork.
The stamp ran out of ink at the worst moment.
